objective: Explore the Fargodeep Mine, then return to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.

description: The mine in Northshire isn't the only one with problems!  I have reports that the Fargodeep Mine in Elwynn has also become a haven for Kobolds.
Explore the mine and confirm these reports, then return to me.  The mine is almost due south of Goldshire, between the Stonefield and Maclure homesteads.
progress: What do you have to report, <name>? Have you been to the Fargodeep Mine?
completion: This is bad news. What's next, dragons?!? We'll have to increase our patrols near that mine. Thanks for your efforts, <name>. And hold a moment... I might have another task for you.
